assets.title: Barter mismatch
assets.purpose: Make incompatible direct-exchange wants visible.
assets.alt: Three people offer rice, shoes and cooking oil while pictorial callouts show different wants and broken arrows show exchanges failing.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Money-mediated exchange
assets.purpose: Show a person selling to one party and buying from another using a common medium.
assets.alt: In two consecutive scenes the same woman sells rice to a man for plain tokens, then uses the tokens to buy shoes from a different man.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Choosing among goods
assets.purpose: Show a learner weighing everyday alternatives without prescribing a correct choice.
assets.alt: A thoughtful shopper in a white hoodie considers a notebook, shoes and a cooking pot on a simple store shelf.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Transaction through shared ledger
assets.purpose: Show two people communicating a payment through distributed verification.
assets.alt: A sender and receiver use phones on opposite sides of several connected computers, each displaying the same pictorial ledger.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Peer-to-peer communication
assets.purpose: Show a route between two peers without a central approving authority.
assets.alt: Two peers with phones stand on opposite sides of an evenly connected network, with one path highlighted between them.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Wallet controls keys
assets.purpose: Show a wallet managing keys and sending instructions to a separately held ledger.
assets.alt: A learner uses a phone with a key symbol; an instruction travels to a separate network of public-ledger computers.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Who controls the keys
assets.purpose: Contrast user key control and remote service key control without ranking safety.
assets.alt: Two equally weighted scenes show a person with a key beside their phone and a person whose phone connects to a remote server holding the key.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Receiving notification
assets.purpose: Make the receiver role concrete without depicting payable details.
assets.alt: The business owner smiles calmly at a phone displaying a pictorial incoming arrow and check mark.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Check before sending
assets.purpose: Reinforce reviewing checks before approving a payment.
assets.alt: The older learner examines a phone showing pictorial checks for recipient, destination and amount before approving anything.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Community conversation
assets.purpose: Show voluntary community discussion about Bitcoin.
assets.alt: Four adults discuss a simple Bitcoin learning card together, with two phones resting nearby.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Lightning sender and receiver
assets.purpose: Illustrate the sender and receiver roles in a Lightning payment.
assets.alt: Two adults hold phones, linked by a directional line with a small Lightning symbol.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Coffee purchase
assets.purpose: Connect a phone payment with an ordinary merchant exchange.
assets.alt: A server hands a cup of coffee to a customer while both check their own phones at a simple counter.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Generic Bitcoin ATM
assets.purpose: Illustrate an ATM as one possible exchange route.
assets.alt: A technical learner holds a phone beside a generic Bitcoin ATM dispensing plain unmarked banknotes.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Circular local exchange
assets.purpose: Show a hypothetical circular flow among people exchanging goods and services.
assets.alt: Four adults with teaching materials, shoes, repair tools and produce are connected by a clockwise payment path.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Learning network video call
assets.purpose: Show informal connection with an education network.
assets.alt: An older learner holds tea during a video call with three fellow educators and learners.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Water and context
assets.purpose: Show how context changes the usefulness of the same bottle of water.
assets.alt: The same water bottle appears in a well-stocked shop refrigerator and beside a thirsty adult in a sparse hot setting.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Forms of money through history
assets.purpose: Provide a pictorial sequence accompanying the guide's historical explanation.
assets.alt: A sequence of direct exchange, commodity goods, coins, representative paper, institutional money and digital devices.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Three alternative assets
assets.purpose: Show three examples of assets without ranking or investment recommendation.
assets.alt: Three equally weighted illustrations show a house with a key handover, an unlabelled stock chart and a simple ingot.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Seven monetary properties
assets.purpose: Support the guide's seven-property reference with distinct pictorial cues.
assets.alt: Seven linked pictorial cues represent durability, portability, divisibility, interchangeability, scarcity, verification and acceptance.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Connected and offline signing devices
assets.purpose: Illustrate connectivity while leaving custody distinctions to adjacent guide text.
assets.alt: A phone with a connectivity symbol is paired with a dedicated hardware device whose connectivity symbol is crossed out.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Three acquisition routes
assets.purpose: Show earning, peer exchange and a generic computer-based exchange as distinct routes.
assets.alt: Three scenes show work rewarded through a phone payment, cash exchanged between peers and a learner using a computer-based exchange.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Merchant accepting Bitcoin
assets.purpose: Illustrate a hypothetical merchant willing to accept Bitcoin.
assets.alt: A merchant stands at a produce stall with a small Bitcoin-symbol sign while a customer holds a phone.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.

assets.title: Course completion and safety review
assets.purpose: Support reviewing safety responsibilities at course completion.
assets.alt: A learner reviews a pictorial checklist with a pen beside a phone and a blank symbolic course certificate.
assets.role: Text-free companion artwork; retain adjacent instructional text.
